olivia: quick context — we're onboarding a new 120B dense model (q4f16 candidate) for Dedicated.
olivia: ran microbenchmarks in us-west1 (H100) and eu-west1 (A100) across short (128) + medium (512) sequences. need recommendations for per-GPU concurrency targets, autoscale headroom, and kernel choices for production pools.
olivia: numbers are rough but representative: p50/p95 token latency for autoreg generation at batch_size=1
olivia: H100/us-west1: p50=18ms, p95=45ms (128); p50=33ms, p95=110ms (512)
olivia: A100/eu-west1: p50=28ms, p95=85ms (128); p50=60ms, p95=210ms (512)
matt: thanks — looks like H100 gives ~1.5–2.0x latency improvement on p95 for medium sequences. what concurrency did you saturate at during these runs?
matt: i pushed concurrent sessions by ramp: H100 hit steady throughput at 28 concurrent gen streams (512), A100 at ~16 streams (512) before p95 jumped nonlinearly.
matt: raw throughput (tokens/sec, 512 seq window): H100 ~1200 t/s, A100 ~650 t/s.
samir: kernel notes — for 512 we've been falling back to cutlass kernels for some attention sizes which explains p95 tails on A100. H100 has a better autotuned triton path for q4f16 on this arch.
samir: q4f16 quantization looks good for ppl/regression but we should run evals vs our regression suite (sanity + adversarial prompts) before rolling.
luca: for Dedicated sizing my recommendation: target conservative concurrency that keeps p95 under OUR_SLO (150ms). suggested per-GPU targets:
- H100: target concurrency 18 for steady-state, burst headroom to 28 (reserve ~60% of saturation)
- A100: target concurrency 10 steady-state, burst to 16 (reserve ~60% of saturation)
luca: map that to pool sizing: if customer SLO requires 2000 concurrent streams globally, allocate mix of H100/A100 with these per-GPU numbers and an autoscale buffer.
jin: ops/warmup note — kv-cache warmup + embedding cache will increase initial latency for cold connections. add a short warm pool (1-2 min) and prefer pre-warmed GPUs for canary traffic.
jin: also watch for tail jitter from bursty short-sequence workloads — our batching heuristics can temporarily increase latency.
clara: autoscale policy stub (keep it simple for initial rollout):
```
{"policy": "concurrency_based", "scale_up_threshold": 0.75, "scale_down_threshold": 0.45, "min_replicas": 2, "max_replicas": 50, "scale_cooldown": 45}
```
clara: interpret thresholds vs per-GPU target concurrency: scale when avg_util >= 75% of target_concurrency.
clara: we should also pin a fallback model variant (smaller quantized or lower seq_len optimized) to avoid full degradation if capacity is exhausted.
matt: to translate to cost: H100 per-gpu supports ~18 steady streams => 18 * tokens_per_stream * token_cost => do quick per-token cost calc for finance before finalizing commit.
olivia: action items so far:
- matt: run full regression evals on q4f16 and post quality diffs (assign)
- samir: validate kernel fallback paths and add a flag to force-cutlass for long sequences in canary
- luca: produce sizing calculator for mixed pools (H100/A100) with these concurrency numbers
- jin: add warm-pool + prewarm playbook to Dedicated runbook
- clara: implement autoscale policy prototype and fallback model wiring
olivia: tentative rollout plan: canary 5% traffic to Dedicated H100 pool with warm-pool enabled, monitor p95 and quality metrics for 48h, then expand to 25% if stable.
deploy-bot: Deployment event: canary pool '120b-h100-canary' created by clara at 2319876600 :rocket:
clara: started canary deployment, tagging metrics stream as "120b-canary-h100-usw1" — will post dashboards shortly.
matt: initial evals show no >2% quality regression on our L1 prompts; full suite still running, will update by EOD.
samir: added a runtime flag: `--force-cutlass-long-seq=true` for canary to reduce p95 on A100 fallback cases (doc in PR).
olivia: thanks all — let's keep the thread for updates. ping me if you need quota changes for Dedicated pools. :thumbsup:
